comments.text: Applied targeted poetry.lock remediation pass on branch fix/dependabot-findings. Updated vulnerable packages to first patched releases in lock: pillow 12.2.0, cryptography 46.0.7, pytest 9.0.3, Mako 1.3.11 (pypdf already 6.10.2). Validation: poetry check => pass; snyk test --package-manager=poetry => no vulnerable paths. Dependabot API still shows alerts open for poetry.lock on default branch until these changes land there.
